title: Homelab — production-style edge, identity & fleet ops
description: Six-host fleet with Traefik/CrowdSec/Authelia at the edge, app nodes, media as a workload line, and Beszel/Dozzle/Homarr across the board — not "I run Plex."
beforeAfter: Ad-hoc containers on one box → named hosts, ingress + authz, observability, and clear blast-radius boundaries.
talkingPoint: Walk me through how you'd isolate a compromised edge node without taking the media or app planes down.
bullets: Edge/ingress plane: Traefik + CrowdSec + Authelia (+ Pangolin) on hlx-prod-rpi-01 / hlx-edge-01
App plane: Docker hosts + balerion — services with Unmanic where needed
Fleet ops: Beszel / Dozzle / Homarr for health, logs, and ops UX across all six hosts

title: Cut file-upload latency and feed onboarding on a Java data platform
description: Owned the path from slow batch uploads and week-long source onboarding to config-driven loaders and measurable latency wins — Spring on AKS, with observability wired for real ops.
beforeAfter: Uploads stuck in long batch windows; new API sources took weeks to land → 60% ↓ upload latency, 40% ↓ feed onboarding time via config-driven API Source Loader.
talkingPoint: How did you keep the loader config-driven without turning every new feed into a deploy?
ownershipLine: End-to-end ownership of upload path + source onboarding UX for platform consumers.
bullets: Drove upload processing from multi-minute batch pain to a latency outcome hiring managers can probe (60% ↓)
Shipped config-driven API Source Loader — onboarding measured in days-class cycles (40% ↓)
Instrumented Spring services (OTel → Datadog) so regressions show up in ops, not in war rooms

title: ART — Automatic Recovery Tool for billing data integrity
description: Built a Spring Boot recovery console that detects inconsistencies, produces actionable reports, and supports remediation — cutting operational overhead instead of adding another ticket queue.
beforeAfter: Manual chase of inconsistent billing/ops data → 25% ↓ operational overhead with detect → report → remediate loop.
talkingPoint: What's the difference between a recovery tool operators trust and one they ignore?
ownershipLine: Designed and delivered ART used by ops for inconsistency detection and remediation workflows.
bullets: Detect data inconsistencies early with actionable reports (not raw dumps)
Remediation path operators can run without engineering on every incident
Outcome: 25% ↓ operational overhead on the recovery workflow
